_comment: Team catalog. Team identity is expressed through the AUTHENTIC kit — real colours, crest, name and number, asked for directly and legibly. A measured A/B showed the model renders 'SPURS 1' cleanly when asked, and renders jersey-shaped gibberish when told a jersey must have no lettering. Specific real kits are also what make a frame read as broadcast footage rather than an AI render.
